issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

searchMethod.description:
Set this field to `Grid` to ignore the Max Combinations configuration and
allow users to start training with any number of HPO combinations.
Set this field to `Random` to enforce the Max Combinations configuration.

maxCombinations.description:
When the Search Method is set to `Random`, this field specifies the maximum number
of allowed combinations to be processed, i.e. the maximum number of training jobs
that can be started for a single HPO run.
If the number of HPO combinations is greater than this value, the user will not be
able to start training, to avoid excessive resource consumption.

hpoEnabledDefault.description:
For model templates that have HPO hyperparameters, enable/disable
HPO values by default when configuring a new model.
